body.message:
Good evening Alex,

I hope you are well.

This is a reminder that your rent payment has now been overdue for more than four days. As you previously mentioned that the payment would be made on 10 August, we expected to receive it by then. However, as of today, 11 August, we have still not received the payment.

Unfortunately, as we are unable to hold the booking any longer without receiving the outstanding payment, you will be required to check out tomorrow.

A member of our team will be at the apartment tomorrow to carry out the inspection and complete the check-out process.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation
